case_checks.evidence: camera-component.en.txt has four camera blocks: fixed front, one straight dolly, fixed front, fixed side. Each has one principal behaviour; no per-accent redirection.
Shared clock: dolly starts 2.000 s, arrives/stops 3.500 s, turn begins 4.000 s. arrival - turn onset = -0.500 s; fixed observation never stops the dancers.
Response is anticipate_hit during the dolly and stable_observe otherwise; independent edit_policy is phase_match_cut at 5.000 s, inside the 4.000–6.000 s turn.
All four blocks contain CAMERA POSITION, CAMERA GEOMETRY, CAMERA MOVEMENT, MOVEMENT TRIGGER and END CAMERA POSITION. Each static block explicitly uses none for movement and trigger.

Front dolly follows negative Y from (0,-6,1.2) to (0,-8,1.2) m; side view is prepositioned at (+8,0,1.2) m. Lens, axis, height and arrival are specified. These dimensions are authored assumptions, not measured set data.
The current request calls for anticipation, not delayed_observer. No lag, overshoot or reacquisition is prescribed.

Current user constraints override historical defaults: lead is exactly 0.500 s, cut occurs mid-turn, and no freeze ending or flash is used. Historical low-angle, dwell and 1.5–2 s anticipation values are not imported.
This is an authored camera component with a static plan audit only. No media or inference was run; actual timing, body continuity and generated quality remain unverified.

user_constraints: Camera arrives 0.5 seconds before turn onset
Exactly one action/rotation-phase match cut to the side during the turn
Dancers remain in continuous motion; no freeze frames

blocks.trigger: shared clock 2.000 s during moving preparation

authored_assumptions: Turn occupies 4.000–6.000 seconds; cut at 5.000 seconds
Stage coordinates, camera distances and 1.2 m height are production design choices
Two diagonal turn centres preserve two-person visibility
Existing full prompt supplies identity, scene, wardrobe, style and audio; this component does not invent audio alignment
verification_limits: No source media supplied or inspected
No H3 inference or video quality validation
No measured beat timing or actual stage dimensions
Component documents are not generation segments, so the existing audit does not inspect their prose; semantic review is recorded by the plan author
